boundary.resolution: IMGDEC expands a word stream into GP0 upload headers and payload, not direct VRAM writes or rendering. Input32/output64/history4096 capacities, 32-bit words and adjacent transport ownership are explicitly source/semantic checked (ICR/IST).

registers.resolution: All nine words include exact address/access/reset/bit behavior; five configuration admission gates, full-word retention, START self-clear/retained high bits, STATUS replacement and progress/data effects are independently checked. Internal save state is not invented as cartridge registers.

datapath.resolution: All four token fields/ranges, literal/repeat/zero/overlapping back-reference behavior, shared texture/CLUT history, generated headers, raw GP0 words, modulo counters and exact worked output streams are independently audited.

visibility.resolution: Accepted configuration versus CPU stall/DMA rejection, submitted versus consumed input, atomic whole output batches, DATA latch/ownership, block-ending DMA updates and output-read completion are source-checked; partial prefix retention and new START are distinct.

timing.resolution: Installed33868800 cycles/s, two cycles per output word including headers,16-word payload groups and3-word headers, delayed service/input starvation/backpressure, DREQ thresholds and overlapping DMA transport are explicit. Eleven paired timing edges plus final output agree; no electrical/end-to-end rating is invented.

interrupts.resolution: DONE and FORMAT_FAULT both raise central bit7; DMA bits0/8, masks/ACK, unrelated pending and accepted-interrupt HALT latch are separate. Post-DONE eligible empty DATA read re-raises IRQ80; exact-count caution and paired ACK/read evidence are recorded.

faults.resolution: Read-only access fault, all actual malformed-stream causes/order, equality-only exhaustion, modulo counts, partial output, withdrawn DREQ and potentially stranded DMA are documented. Fixed demonstration uses CPU for its fault job; no unsourced ABORT/general recovery is invented.

reset.resolution: Unit reset cancels pending decoding, clears all nine words/FIFOs/progress/history validity and pause; it does not central-ACK. Fresh START and system-pause boundary/preservation/resumption are separately source-checked.

programming.resolution: Actual53+258line two-module typed BLua cartridge retains RAM, GP0, CPU fault and fresh-START recovery, then draws the successful indexed upload through GPU/PCRTC. One const and seven ordered entry parts reproduce both executed files exactly. Actual ordinary build/playback and derived guest case preserve all26 RAM results, phase/IRQ/fault/recovery observations and20 source/CLUT GPUREAD words, adding360 picture-row words, one outside-background word and a real full output plate. Independent actual-source/program/image and public-reader checks pass; optional readback remains outside the printed cartridge. Final print is pending.
